name: Vitamin X to Z
source: In the middle of the events of the two original games, both classes decide to take a break and go to a winter resort. Manami and Yuri will relax in the hot springs while they get closer to the guys.
translation: 在两场原始比赛的比赛进行到一半时，两个班都决定休息一下，去避暑胜地。真奈美和尤里会在温泉中放松身心，同时与伙伴们更加亲近。
